qAndA.answer: To build and manage a thriving medieval town, ensuring the well-being of the townspeople and defending them from threats.
qAndA.question: What is the primary objective of the game?

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Woohoo! Welcome to Townsman VR!
You've arrived on one of over a dozen islands
then you can explore in rain supreme.
And exploring is easy.
Just grab anywhere to move and use both hands
to rotate all zoom in and out.
After you get the hang of it and stop behaving like a hoke.
You'll see that there's more than meets the eye.
In the first place, Townsman VR is a medieval city builder.
Where you freely place construction sites
and then let your townies do the hard work.
Not only can you help them get there directly,
but you can also transport the resources yourself.
As a gentle ruler, you have to take care of your Townsman.
So they have enough food and water.
A healthy body is an able body.
They'll work together and even research new technologies
or help you trade with your neighbours.
But not everyone out there wants to be your friend.
So recruit soldiers to fend off ill-mannered folks.
And if it's getting serious, a catapult won't hurt.
Except when it does.
And well, this is Townsman VR.

youtube_description:
#HandyGames #TownsmenVR #TMVR

Build a medieval village within a completely interactively simulated world!

Townsmen VR uses the exciting possibilities of virtual reality to further enhance the classic city building game with entirely new gameplay experiences and interactive mechanics.

Lean back, relax and watch the bustling life of your villagers or actively get involved to speed up processes and move workers and resources directly where they are needed. You are able to seamlessly change between the all-encompassing view of a god and the detailed view of a citizen, able to follow the colorful life of your village. There is a lot to discover! But watch out for the Black Knight’s plundering hordes!

Get it here!
